rv.q: A visually wondrous show – but still more for adults than for children.
Their performance is all that works best here: Shakespeare made easy but carefully layered and effortlessly moving too.
The Unicorn's first major co-production with the Royal Shakespeare Company is a breathtaking triumph.
This is a wonderful production to introduce a child to the world of Shakespeare.
This is a rich, warm, and visually engaging production, presented by an energised and playful cast with clear stage-audience rapport.

All the same, this is a clear, accessible production of A Midsummer Night’s Dream that entertained the numerous young children in its audience who were perhaps having their first taste of Shakespeare.

cn.t: Critics praise this RSC-Unicorn collaboration as an accessible, spirited adaptation for young audiences that preserves Shakespeare's language while incorporating imaginative video design and playful captioning to enchanting effect.
